add_block.new_heading: A healthy chef for hire on the Palm
new_paragraphs: A fair share of Palm bookings ask for the food to be light before they ask for it to be impressive, and that is a menu brief like any other. A healthy chef for hire here means grilled and roasted in place of fried, olive oil doing the work of butter, vegetables and whole grains carrying the plate, fish more often than red meat, and dessert built on fruit and citrus. If you train and count what you eat, give the chef the targets when you enquire — protein per plate, a carbohydrate range, no added sugar, no dairy — and the menu is designed to them from the start instead of being adjusted on the day. Guests who are not eating to a plan get the same dishes at full richness, so nothing on the table announces itself as the diet option. Healthy catering in Dubai sets out how the menus are built.

new_paragraphs: From AED 700 per person, with the exact figure set by guest count, menu and service level. Everything is priced per head, and the palm jumeirah private chef cost comes down as the group grows: an intimate dinner for two runs nearer AED 950–1,300 per person, six guests around AED 750–1,000, and ten or more from AED 700. Multi-course tasting menus and rare ingredients sit at the higher end; relaxed sharing menus at the lower. There are no hidden extras — groceries, staff and equipment are listed in the proposal. add_block.new_heading: Why myCHEF for private dining on the Palm
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. No chef is offered for a Palm Jumeirah booking before clearing identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews — a continuous standard, not a one-time tick. We are honest about it: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the chef whose background fits it, which is how you get a genuinely luxury private chef Palm Jumeirah experience instead of a lottery.

For an occasion like this, that might be Ahmed Al-Rashid — 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique — who designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and served to exacting standards. To give one example, we delivered a seven-course terrace dinner for twelve on a Frond villa, coordinating security access, a beach-side canapé reception and a plated main service, all cleared by midnight.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Palm Jumeirah?
Private dining in Palm Jumeirah starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of Palm Jumeirah do you serve?
All of Palm Jumeirah — The Fronds (A–M) beach villas, Shoreline and Palm Tower apartments and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included in a private chef booking?
Included is menu design, a vetted chef cooking on site, service staff where needed, plating, setup and full cleanup, plus itemised groceries and equipment. You keep a clean kitchen.
How far in advance should I book?

About 48 hours covers a standard private-chef dinner, and 5 to 7 days suits a bespoke menu or a larger private event. Short-notice requests are assessed individually against chef availability, so ask even if your date is close.
Can you cater a private beach BBQ or dinner party on the Palm?
Yes. Each Frond villa has its own beach, which suits a live BBQ, grazing spread or a plated multi-course dinner. We bring the grill, staff and everything needed, and clear it all afterwards.
Do you cater halal, vegetarian and allergen-aware menus?

Yes. Every menu can be built halal, vegetarian or vegan, and the chef designs around your requirements from the start. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
How do I book?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Who is the best chef in the UAE?

No ranking settles that, and any list claiming to is one person's opinion. The useful question is narrower — who is the best chef for your evening — and myCHEF answers it by matching cuisine, format and guest count to a chef who cooks that food regularly in the UAE. A Levantine grill on a Frond beach and a French tasting menu for eight are two different people.
How much does it usually cost to have a private chef?

On the Palm the usual range is AED 700–950 per person once you are at ten guests or more. Six guests sit around AED 750–1,000, four around AED 800–1,100, and a dinner for two nearer AED 950–1,300, because the chef's time is spread across fewer plates.
Can I book a chef for healthy or macro-managed menus?

Yes. Give the chef your targets when you enquire — protein per plate, carbohydrate range, no added sugar, no dairy — and the menu is designed to them, with the rest of the table served the same dishes at full richness.
For private chef palm jumeirah, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
